vision.boxes.title: Ko‘z boxes
vision.setup.noEntrance.title: Visitors need an entrance camera
vision.setup.noEntrance.body: Give one camera the Entrance role and draw the line people cross at the door.
vision.setup.noCounter.title: Queues need a counter camera
vision.setup.noCounter.body: Give the camera over the till the Counter role and draw the queue and the place behind the counter.
vision.pitch.title: Your cameras already see everything. Now they tell you.
vision.pitch.body: A Ko‘z box at the pharmacy reads the cameras you already have, counts people and sends Daybook only numbers, alerts and, when you ask, a picture or a short video.
vision.pitch.point1.title: Visitors against receipts
vision.pitch.point1.body: Every hour: how many came in, how many bought and how many left without buying.
vision.pitch.point2.title: Queue alerts in Telegram
vision.pitch.point2.body: When the queue grows or nobody is at the counter, the pharmacists on shift get a photo and a button: I’m going.
vision.pitch.point3.title: A video of any sale
vision.pitch.point3.body: Open the till’s camera at the moment of a sale, a void or cash taken out.
vision.pitch.privacy: No face recognition: Ko‘z sees the shapes of people, never who they are. Video stays at the pharmacy.
vision.pitch.ctaHint: About five minutes with a PC at the pharmacy.
vision.pitch.ask: Ask the owner to pair a Ko‘z box in Cameras and boxes.
vision.live.title: Live
vision.live.description: What the cameras see right now, with the queue and how long people wait.
vision.live.privacy: People are found as shapes; nobody is recognised.
vision.camera.denied: Live pictures need the right to watch cameras
vision.camera.waiting: Waiting for the first picture from the box
vision.camera.error: The picture didn’t arrive. Trying again
vision.camera.noneBody: Pair a Ko‘z box: its cameras appear here once they are on.
vision.banner.unattendedBody: {n} waiting for {wait}, nobody at the counter
vision.alerts.title: Alerts
vision.alerts.description: Every queue and empty counter the boxes reported, with its photo and what happened next.
vision.alerts.emptyBody: When a queue grows or nobody is at the counter, it shows here with its photo.
vision.alert.title: Alert
vision.alert.offlineBody: The box sent nothing for a while. Check that the PC is on and online.

vision.clip.requesting: Asking the box for the video
vision.clip.fetching: The box is cutting the video and sending it
vision.clip.fetchingHint: Usually under a minute. You can close this: the video stays with the alert.
vision.clip.failure.not_recorded: This moment wasn’t recorded: neither the box nor the NVR has it.

vision.clip.failure.too_old: The recording of that time is no longer kept.

vision.clip.failure.unknown: Something went wrong on the box.

vision.clip.refused.no_camera: No counter camera watches this till. Choose the till on a camera in Cameras and boxes.
vision.clip.refused.forbidden: Videos need the right to watch cameras.
vision.clip.refused.offline: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
vision.clip.refused.generic: The video couldn’t be asked for.
vision.clip.unmasked: Videos cut from the NVR are not masked.
vision.clip.keys: Space plays, the arrows skip 5 s, F fills the screen
vision.cameras.title: Cameras and boxes
vision.cameras.description: The Ko‘z boxes at your pharmacies and the cameras they read: what each is for, its zones and the till a counter camera watches.
vision.boxes.emptyBody: A box is a PC at the pharmacy that reads the cameras. Pair one to begin.
vision.boxes.removeBody: Its key stops working at once. Its cameras stay, offline, with their history.
vision.boxes.repairBody: The box stops sending until it is paired again with the new code.
vision.pair.title: Pair a Ko‘z box
vision.pair.description: A Ko‘z box is a PC at the pharmacy that reads the cameras. Name it and choose its branch.
vision.pair.name: Name
vision.pair.codeTitle: Run this on the pharmacy’s PC
vision.pair.step1.title: Install Ko‘z on the PC
vision.pair.step1.body: Any Windows or Linux PC at the pharmacy that stays on and sees the cameras’ network.
vision.pair.step2.title: Run the command
vision.pair.step2.body: Open a terminal on that PC and paste the line above. The code works once, for 15 minutes.
vision.pair.step3.title: Wait for the cameras
vision.pair.step3.body: The box finds the NVR’s cameras and sends a picture of each. This window follows it.
vision.pair.pairedBody: Its cameras are arriving. Turn on the ones Ko‘z should analyse and give each a role.
vision.pair.found: {n} cameras found | {n} camera found | {n} cameras found
vision.cameras.analyseOff: {name}: Ko‘z no longer counts on it
vision.cameras.name: Name

vision.cameras.needs.staff: Needs the place behind the counter
vision.cameras.refreshing: The box is sending a new picture
vision.cameras.emptyBody: Cameras appear here once a Ko‘z box is paired.
vision.zones.title: Zones
vision.zones.description: Draw where people stand: their feet decide which zone they are in.
vision.zones.hint.select: Drag a corner or a zone to move it. Click an edge to add a corner.
vision.zones.hint.queue: Where customers stand waiting at the counter.
vision.zones.hint.staff: Behind the counter, where pharmacists stand.
vision.zones.hint.line: Two points across the door. The arrow points inside.
vision.zones.hint.floor: An area where people are counted.
vision.zones.hint.mask: Blacked out in every picture; nobody is counted there.
vision.zones.drawing: Click to add corners; Enter or a double-click finishes, Esc cancels.
vision.zones.drawingTouch: Tap to add corners, then Finish.
vision.zones.drawingLine: Click the two ends of the line.
vision.zones.empty: No zones yet. Choose a tool and draw on the picture.
vision.zones.problem.too_many: At most {max} zones on one camera.
vision.zones.problem.kind: A zone of an unknown kind.
vision.zones.problem.id_format: A zone’s name may use only small letters, digits, - and _ (up to 16).
vision.zones.problem.id_duplicate: Two zones have the same name.
vision.zones.problem.polygon_few: A zone needs at least {min} corners.
vision.zones.problem.polygon_many: A zone has at most {max} corners.
vision.zones.problem.line_points: An entrance line has exactly 2 points.
vision.zones.problem.line_side: Choose which side of the line is inside.
vision.zones.problem.range: Every corner must be inside the picture.
vision.zones.selfIntersect: This shape crosses itself, so people may land in the wrong zone.
vision.zones.maskNote: Hidden areas are black in pictures and live views. Videos cut from the NVR are not masked.
vision.zones.noSnapshot: No picture of this camera yet. Ask the box for one.
vision.zones.leaveBody: The zones you drew on this camera will be lost.
vision.zones.notFound: This camera isn’t here any more
vision.settings.title: Ko‘z settings
vision.settings.description: When alerts go off, who gets them, what pictures show and how long things are kept.
vision.settings.readonly: Only people who manage Ko‘z can change these.
vision.settings.rules.title: Alert rules
vision.settings.rules.body: Counted on counter cameras that have a queue zone and the place behind the counter.
vision.settings.queue_people.hint: A queue alert needs at least this many people waiting…
vision.settings.queue_wait_s.hint: …and someone waiting at least this long.
vision.settings.unattended_s.hint: A customer waits and nobody stands behind the counter for this long.
vision.settings.clear_after_s.hint: An alert ends after this long below its rule.
vision.settings.cooldown_s.hint: The same alert on the same camera goes to Telegram again only after this long. It still shows here every time.
vision.settings.who.title: Who gets alerts
vision.settings.who.body: Alerts come with a photo and the button “I’m going”; whoever presses it is shown to the others.
vision.settings.notify_on_shift: Whoever is on shift at that branch
vision.settings.notify_on_shift.hint: Through the employee bot: the people checked in there right now.
vision.settings.notify_managers.hint: Through the bot they use for owner messages. Nobody gets the same alert twice.
vision.settings.privacy.title: Privacy
vision.settings.privacy.body: Ko‘z finds the shapes of people and never recognises faces. Video stays at the pharmacy; only what someone asks for leaves it.
vision.settings.privacy_blur.hint: Hidden areas are always black; this also blurs every head.
vision.settings.alert_photo.hint: The counter camera’s picture with the boxes and the waiting times.
vision.settings.recording.title: Recording and storage
vision.settings.recording.body: How the box records and how long Daybook keeps numbers, photos and videos.
vision.settings.record_counter: Record counter cameras at the pharmacy
vision.settings.record_counter.hint: The box keeps a rolling recording, so a sale’s video comes quickly even without an NVR.
vision.settings.record_hours.hint: On the box’s disk, then recorded over.
vision.settings.analysis_fps.hint: More is more precise and needs a stronger PC.
vision.settings.stats_keep_days.hint: Visitors, queues and waits by minute.
vision.review.title: Worth a look
vision.review.description: Voided sales and cash taken out of a till while its camera saw nobody at the counter.
vision.review.emptyBody: No voids or payouts happened with an empty counter on this day.
vision.review.why: Ko‘z lists these because a void or cash out with no customer at the counter is worth a second look. Most have a good reason.
